note: The five-tier vocabulary shared across all BHIL frameworks. Order is fixed. Every rendered headline metric either carries VERIFIED or CORROBORATED, or shows its class label on screen.

tiers.helm_application: System-of-record extracts; designer-stated facts in on-record interviews

tiers.definition: Two or more independent sources agree
tiers.helm_application: Studio credits confirmed across trade press; two data extracts reconciled
Single export; typeface attributions from fan wikis
Derived metrics; estimated ranges; language-fit rationale

tiers.definition: Self-reported, client-claimed, or vendor-claimed; quarantined until reconciled
tiers.helm_application: Client targets, benchmarks, self-reported rates; vendor performance claims

synthetic_flag.label: SYNTHETIC
synthetic_flag.definition: Row generated by HELM when the input is narrative only. Not an evidence tier. Every synthetic row carries this flag and the assumption that produced it.
